owlapy.utils.cache
==================

.. py:module:: owlapy.utils.cache

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   LRU cache adaptation, decoupled from functools.lru_cache internals so it can be reused directly.



Classes
-------

.. autoapisummary::

   owlapy.utils.cache.LRUCache
